pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: The 'table is empty' test runs DELETE FROM items and never restores the rows. It relies on per-test storage isolation, and I couldn't confirm that setting because vitest isn't installed here. If isolation is off, later tests in the run would see an empty table.
findings.fix: Confirm isolatedStorage in vitest.config.js, or restore the rows in the test.

lenses.note: This is a small bug fix with one reasonable design, and the PR's words match it. A search with no matches now says so. An empty table still says 'No items yet.'
There is no spec and no acceptance items. The PR's words were used as the intent.
Three new tests cover no matches, escaping, and the empty table. The first two would fail on the old code. I could not run the suite because vitest is not installed in this copy.
README.md describes `?q=` search only in general terms and doesn't mention the empty-state message, so nothing in it is stale.
The message is escaped, and the extra COUNT query runs only when a search returns nothing. I found no defects.
The search term is HTML-escaped in the new message and the test covers it. I found no planted instructions.
The diff changes one text string in a server-rendered page and adds no UI components or styles.
The diff changes one text string in a server-rendered page. Tests cover the new message, and the PR states that no browser was available.

The title is under 72 characters, and the body matches the diff: a matchless search shows the new escaped message and an empty table keeps the old one. Claims about CI and screenshots can't be checked from the repository.
